shared_elements: upright rectangular slab surface divided by straight incised lines
horizontal band of repeated short vertical strokes / row of small linear signs
framing border line running along the edge of the field
justification: The only real correspondence is formal rather than iconographic: both are upright slabs whose fields are organised by straight incised lines, and both contain a horizontal band of repeated short vertical strokes (hatching in A, rows of angular signs in B). Otherwise the content is wholly different: A shows a populated figural scene with arcaded compartments, human figures, quadrupeds and a large bird-like creature in relief, while B carries no representational imagery at all, only linear sign-rows along the borders.
